answer: Bind each epoch's reward to a sequential verifiable-delay-function puzzle unique to the agent's address, like a pearl forming layer by layer over real time. However many sybil clones crowd a harbor of identities, each must grind its own puzzle: wall-clock time cannot be parallelized, so N fakes cost N delays. A per-identity reward cap per epoch keeps marginal payout below that cost, so attacker economics stay negative. Like yarrow spreading root by root, sybil scale is throttled to linear time. Limit: vast farms can still brute-force through, and slow honest devices wait longer.
